create_cuda_stream: create a torch.cuda.Stream with a specified device and priority level
create_cuda_event: create a torch.cuda.Event for timing or stream synchronization
test_stream_wait_event: test the Stream.wait_event method to make a stream wait for a CUDA event
test_stream_wait_stream: test the Stream.wait_stream method to synchronize with another CUDA stream
test_stream_record_event: test the Stream.record_event method to record a CUDA event in a stream
test_event_elapsed_time: test the Event.elapsed_time method to measure time between two CUDA events
test_event_from_ipc_handle: test the Event.from_ipc_handle method to reconstruct an event from an IPC handle
test_stream_synchronize: test the Stream.synchronize method to wait for all kernels in a stream to complete
test_event_synchronize: test the Event.synchronize method to wait for a CUDA event to complete
test_stream_query: test the Stream.query method to check if all work in a stream has completed
